Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
Origins Early Bird Registration is now Open!

It is that time again and a new year means Origins Registration for Early Bird is open.

Be sure to join us for another outstanding event.

Co-sponsored by Mayfair Games, Origins Game Fair takes place June 12 thru June 16 in Columbus, Ohio, at the Greater Columbus Convention Center.

To help our attendees and families, Origins has once again held our admission prices flat. That means NO INCREASE in attendance fees for this year!

Origins is proud to announce our Artist Guest of Honor: Charles Urbach! You can find out more about Charles on his website: www.angelfire.com/id/hawkrune/

If you have already registered for 2013 we look forward to seeing you at the show. If not, Origins is pleased to announce that:

Origins Early Bird Registration is now open. Please  click here to register.

Upcoming announcements:

Other guest announcements…
Hotel updates…
Ribbon program reminders…

Be sure to follow us on  Facebook and watch the  Origins Game Fair website for updates and new information.
